mapper.select: SELECT batch_id, executed_at, status, run_id FROM settlement_batch ORDER BY batch_id DESC
SELECT batch_id, executed_at, status, run_id FROM settlement_batch WHERE batch_id = #{batchId}
SELECT batch_id, executed_at, status, run_id FROM settlement_batch WHERE run_id = #{runId}
SELECT batch_id, executed_at, status, run_id FROM settlement_batch WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND CAST(executed_at AS DATE) = CAST(#{businessDate} AS DATE) ORDER BY batch_id LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM settlement_batch WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND CAST(executed_at AS DATE) = CAST(#{executedAt} AS DATE)
